title: Unflatten a flat index
hints: Row-major strides for `[d0 d1 d2]` are `d1*d2`, `d2` and `1` (lesson 0.4).
Divide by the axis's stride to drop the axes to its right, then take `mod` its size to drop the axes to its left.
axis 0: `f / (d1*d2)`; axis 1: `f / d2 % d1`; axis 2: `f % d2`.

answer.explain: A row-major flat index is `i*(d1*d2) + j*d2 + k`. Dividing by an axis's stride removes everything to its right, and `% size` removes everything to its left. Axis 0 needs no `%` because `f < d0*d1*d2`. This is exactly the div/mod pair rangeify emits for a `reshape` (lesson 5.5).
